Local Review and Eval runtime from zhiyaunhe-ops/yonclaw-toolkit
Source: https://github.com/zhiyaunhe-ops/yonclaw-toolkit/tree/ad1986e57068165d230329ff94db345de2f9ca8a/runtime

review_domain.py and review_semantics.py are unchanged from that revision.
review.py uses the browser data directory for local SQLite state and can
reopen the previous Toolkit installation's review and task databases.
telegram_review_cards.py retains only the local SQLite history and observation
functions called by review.py and their dependencies.
